events.summary: Scott Steiner defends the WCW Championship in a Four Corners Match against Jeff Jarrett, Sid Vicious and Ric Flair's mystery opponent. Kevin Nash and Diamond Dallas Page defend the Tag Team Championship against The Natural Born Thrillers. Totally Buffed take on Goldberg & DeWayne Bruce.

events.summary: Scott Steiner defends the WCW World Heavyweight Championship against Diamond Dallas Page. Father and son join forces as Dusty Rhodes & Dustin Rhodes take on Ric Flair & Jeff Jarrett.
